answers.evidence:
Verified with `go test -v`. All 23 tests pass:

| Category | Examples | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Basic palindromes | `"racecar"`, `"level"`, `"deified"` | ✅ true |
| Case-insensitive | `"RaceCar"`, `"RACEcar"` | ✅ true |
| With punctuation | `"A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"`, `"No 'x' in Nixon"` | ✅ true |
| Non-palindromes | `"race a car"` | ✅ false |
| Numeric | `"12321"` (true), `"12345"` (false) | ✅ correct |
| Mixed alphanumeric | `"A1B2B1A"`, `"a1b2c3c2b1a"` | ✅ true |
| Empty / single char | `""`, `"a"` | ✅ true |
| Only non-alphanumeric | `"!!!"`, `" , . "` | ✅ true |
